chart_references: Investors have done well recently. Property insurance became especially lucrative. A run of disasters, beginning with a ruinous hurricane season in 2017, prompted insurers to raise prices. After 2022 catastrophes lightened. This helped make the past three years the most profitable in more than a decade (see chart). In 2025 pre-tax profits across the Lloyd’s syndicates were £10.6bn; the ten-year average is £2.5bn. The return on capital exceeded 20%.

extraction.title: Caffeine fix
extraction.subtitle: Why business at London’s specialty-insurance hub has surged Its high profits will not last forever, but it will remain a global leader for specialist cover
extraction.summary: London's specialty insurance market, particularly Lloyd's of London, has seen significant growth, driven by a concentration of specialists and innovation in various insurance sectors. However, the market is beginning to cool as competition increases and prices fall.
